relations.text: アンバレラのSoCの大半は、米テキサス州オースティンと韓国の工場でSamsungが供給している
relations.text_en: The substantial majority of Ambarella's SoCs are supplied by Samsung in Austin, Texas and South Korea

source.label: Ambarella 10-K
source.quote: Currently, the substantial majority of our SoCs are supplied by Samsung Electronics Corporation (Samsung) in facilities located in Austin, Texas and South Korea, from whom we have the option to purchase both fully-assembled and tested products as well as tested die in wafer form for assembly.

relations.text: 組立・検査済み製品と、組立前のウエハ形態の検査済みダイの両方を購入できる
relations.text_en: Ambarella can buy both fully assembled and tested products and tested die in wafer form

source.label: Ambarella 10-K
source.quote: Currently, the majority of our SoCs are supplied by Samsung in facilities located in Austin, Texas and South Korea, from whom we have the option to purchase both fully assembled and tested products as well as tested die in wafer form for assembly.

companies.name: ASEテクノロジー・ホールディング

relations.text: Samsungから検査済みダイを購入する場合、組立はASEに委託している
relations.text_en: For tested die purchased from Samsung, Ambarella contracts the assembly to ASE

source.label: Ambarella 10-K
source.quote: In the case of purchases of tested die from Samsung, we contract the assembly to Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc., or ASE.

companies.name: クアンタ・コンピュータ

relations.text: アンバレラが、Quantaとの提携を拡大して、AIソリューションを開発すると発表した
relations.text_en: Ambarella's CEO says it is expanding its partnership with Quanta to deliver AI technologies

source.label: Ambarella の発表
source.quote: "We are thrilled to expand our partnership with Quanta in delivering innovative AI technologies," said Fermi Wang, president and CEO of Ambarella.
source.note: 2024年の発表で、やや古い情報です。

relations.text: Leapmotorは、アンバレラのCV3-ADを用いた高度運転支援ソリューションの開発を約束した
relations.text_en: Leapmotor committed to creating an advanced intelligent driving solution based on Ambarella's CV3-AD family of automotive AI domain controller SoCs

source.label: Ambarella and Leapmotor joint の発表
source.label_en: Ambarella and Leapmotor joint press release (GlobeNewswire via Nasdaq)
source.quote: As part of this cooperation agreement, Leapmotor committed to creating an advanced intelligent driving solution based on Ambarella’s powerful CV3-AD family of automotive AI domain controller systems-on-chip (SoCs).
source.note: 2024年の発表で、やや古い情報です。

relations.text: Capgeminiが、アンバレラのエッジAIと物理AIの導入を促す、エンジニアリングとシステム統合の支援を提供する
relations.text_en: Capgemini will provide engineering, systems integration, and industry expertise to help accelerate adoption of Ambarella's Edge and Physical AI technologies

source.label: Ambarella and Capgemini joint の発表
source.label_en: Ambarella and Capgemini joint press release
source.quote: Under the agreement, Capgemini will provide engineering, systems integration, and industry expertise to help accelerate customer adoption of Ambarella’s Edge and Physical AI technologies.

companies.name: グーグル(アルファベット)

relations.text: アンバレラの開発者向け環境は、Google Cloud Platform上で提供され、Gemini Enterpriseを活用する

source.quote: agentic AI development capabilities powered by Gemini Enterprise, all delivered on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

relations.text: アンバレラは、Macnicaを非独占の認定ディストリビューターに任命した

source.note_en: The agreement is with Macnica Americas and Macnica ATD Europe (subsidiaries).
